source.author: Anthony James Ingram
source.title: A new type of mechanical walking machine

review.power_to_torque_relation: T = V I / omega, followed by suspended-walker loss subtraction
review.instrument_chain: 0.1 ohm shunt, voltage traces, crankshaft cam/switch timing, oscilloscope

our_assessment.scale_warning: Electrical input divided by crank speed is not calibrated mechanical output torque; subtracting no-load input does not establish load-dependent motor/transmission losses.
our_assessment.acceptance: H4-01 remains open; no source quantities imported as Measurement or calibration targets.
